negative_results: RGB by-value returns do not alone recover the private ABI or scale outlining. Moving the normal scale definition out of the header into the same /GL TU does not alone recover four real calls.
Global /Ob1 restores four RGB scale calls and four ftol2 calls, but changes other complete owners and the parent graph; rejected as a global profile. /GL is preserved in all controls.
Alpha named weights recover size370/frame8, but several reordered expressions/products remain six ordinary bytes different. Stepwise float accumulation in target order closes the complete body.
Scale whole-value casts and explicit raw flag OR do not repair the common scale-copy/flag seam. Small diagnostic score variations are not source-type/ownership proof; all restored.
reproduction: Each record replaces only its declared CPP/HPP hashes in the baseline eleven-input graph. Verified source deltas retained privately; complete diagnostic cold needed after native-control cleanup. Selected baseline/discovery/outlining/final reports and both canonical colds retained; other full reports are superseded by scoped public records.
